claims: C1 people should have transparency into the important rules and reasons behind our models' behavior
C2 transparency is provided primarily through this Model Spec
C3 further transparency is committed to when model behavior is significantly adapted
C4 the commitment to further transparency is especially strong when the adaptation could implicate people's fundamental human rights

concepts.name: transparency_about
concepts.gloss: T is an act of providing transparency about some matter
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of people having transparency and of providing transparency; the act class is needed to carry the preference

concepts.name: transparency_about
concepts.gloss: transparency act T is about matter M
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of transparency into rules and reasons and of further transparency about adaptations; a relation between a transparency act and its subject is needed

concepts.name: important_rule_or_reason
concepts.gloss: R is one of the important rules or reasons behind the models' behavior

concepts.name: model_behavior
concepts.gloss: B is behavior of OpenAI's models

concepts.name: behind_behavior
concepts.gloss: rule or reason R lies behind behavior B
concepts.inference: the clause says transparency is into the rules and reasons behind the models' behavior; a relation between a rule/reason and the behavior it explains is needed

concepts.name: primary_vehicle
concepts.gloss: T is the Model Spec document, the primary vehicle of transparency

concepts.name: significant_adaptation
concepts.gloss: A is a significant adaptation of model behavior, e.g. via system messages or due to local laws

concepts.name: adapts_behavior
concepts.inference: the clause says model behavior is adapted in significant ways; a relation between an adaptation and the behavior it changes is needed

concepts.name: implicates_fundamental_rights
concepts.gloss: adaptation A could implicate people's fundamental human rights

asserts.read_back: providing transparency % is preferred: people should have transparency into the important rules and reasons behind our models' behavior
asserts.body: transparency_about(T, R), important_rule_or_reason(R), model_behavior(B), behind_behavior(R, B)

asserts.read_back: providing transparency % is preferred: the Model Spec is the primary vehicle for transparency into the important rules and reasons behind our models' behavior
asserts.body: transparency_about(T, R), important_rule_or_reason(R), model_behavior(B), behind_behavior(R, B), primary_vehicle(T)

asserts.read_back: providing transparency % is preferred: when model behavior is significantly adapted, further transparency is committed to
asserts.body: significant_adaptation(A), model_behavior(B), adapts_behavior(A, B), transparency_about(T, A)

asserts.read_back: providing transparency % is preferred: when a significant adaptation could implicate people's fundamental human rights, further transparency is especially important
asserts.body: significant_adaptation(A), model_behavior(B), adapts_behavior(A, B), transparency_about(T, A), implicates_fundamental_rights(A)

closure.reason: the clause states a preference for providing transparency; it does not forbid any act of transparency, so silence permits
the clause does not govern whether model behavior may be adapted; it only conditions a transparency commitment on significant adaptation, so silence permits
